item.title: Xcode 27.2 已发布，但 27.1 尚未发布，这意味着开发者仍无法开始开发适配 Duo 的应用
item.description:
在Xcode 27.2发布说明顶部，有一条标记为“重要”的注释：

针对iPhone Duo的iOS SDK和模拟器支持将于本月晚些时候在即将发布的Xcode 27.1中提供。

为Duo适配应用并不是简单的“用新SDK重新编译”就行。情况并非如此。对于几乎所有应用来说，这都将是一项大量的工作，而对于某些应用来说，这将是很多工作。但如果没有Xcode 27.1，开发者就无法开始。开发者一周前就想要这个SDK了。而当10月23日首日预购的买家开始使用他们的Duo时，他们也会希望苹果上周就发布了这个SDK。

 ★

item.title: Apple OS 27.2 测试版已发布；27.1 版是 Duo 独占的 iOS 分支
item.description:
Joe Rossignol, MacRumors:

Apple just seeded the first beta of iOS 27.2 to developers for testing. Yes, you read that correctly: iOS 27.2, not iOS 27.1.

Why no iOS 27.1 beta? The answer likely relates to the iPhone Duo.

This unusual version numbering is entirely about the Duo. The Duo is on its own branch of iOS — heretofore to keep details about its software secret / internal to Apple. When it launches October 23, Apple has already announced it will ship with iOS 27.1. Apple is thus using 27.2 as the version number for the first post-27.0 updates to all of its OSes for devices other than the Duo, to keep those version numbers aligned. The 27.2 releases, I am to understand, are scheduled to ship in October too. I bet they’ll ship after the iPhone Duo launches on October 23. So, putting beta releases aside, we’ll see the versions hit the public in numeric order:

  • All OS 27.0 releases: two days ago.
  • iOS 27.1: October 23, exclusively on the iPhone Duo.
  • All OS 27.2.0 releases: probably in late October, after the 23rd, but with the Duo remaining on its own 27.1 branch.

Then, with a subsequent 27.2.x update, the Duo will join the other devices and version numbers across all devices on all platforms will converge, in November or early December. I believe that’s the plan. Maybe Duo convergence will wait for 27.3, but I think it’ll be a 27.2.x update.

Something similar happened back in 2010 with the original iPad, which launched in April 2010 running what was then still called iPhone OS, version 3.2. iPhone OS 3.2 was exclusive to the iPad — no iPhone or iPod Touch ever ran it. (Those devices remained on v3.1 after the iPad launched.) Apple renamed the OS to iOS at WWDC in June that year, but iOS 4.0 and 4.1 remained exclusive to iPhones and iPod Touches. Convergence with the iPad didn’t happen until iOS 4.2 in late November.

This time it should only take a month or so to converge for the Duo, not seven or eight months like it did for the iPad in 2010. But iOS 27.1 is exclusively for the Duo in a very similar way that 3.2 was exclusive to the iPad.

 ★

item.title: AirPods 5 配备无线充电盒，兼容 MagSafe，但不支持磁吸
item.description:
在我昨天关于苹果上周发布会的长篇评论中，我写道，当你额外支付20美元购买售价150美元的AirPods 5无线充电盒版本时，该充电盒兼容“MagSafe、Qi或Apple Watch充电盘”的感应充电。但苹果AirPods 5技术规格页面的兼容性部分并未列出MagSafe：

兼容USB‑C接口、Apple Watch充电器或Qi认证充电器

这是因为对苹果而言，真正的MagSafe兼容意味着磁吸连接。AirPods 5的充电盒没有MagSafe磁铁（充电盒看起来太小了），只有用于Apple Watch充电盘的磁铁。AirPods Pro的充电盒则同时具备可吸附两种充电盘的磁铁。所以当你用MagSafe给AirPods Pro充电时，它们会吸附在充电盘上。我可以把AirPods Pro 3的充电盒吸附在近乎垂直的MagSafe充电器上，比如我放在键盘旁边的Nomad Stand One。（很棒的产品——你应该买一个。我有两个，另一个放在床头柜上。）但我无法在那个支架上给AirPods 5的充电盒充电，因为它会直接掉下来。

但如果我把AirPods 5的充电盒平放在水平MagSafe充电盘上，它充电完全正常。这是因为MagSafe充电盘本身就兼容Qi。我理解苹果为何在这一点上如此严格——“MagSafe”中的“Mag”含义显而易见——但完全不提及MagSafe，会让人合理地得出AirPods 5无线充电盒根本无法搭配MagSafe使用的结论。

 ★
